title: Pokemon Daily!
author: Peanut7
selftext:
Put lots of time into making a high quality daily Pokemon game! I am a competitive player and played a few wordle style Pokemon games that were sloppy so I wanted to create my own polished version. Please try it out, feel free to share with friends! Thanks :)

[Pokemon Daily](http://battle.peanutbuilds.com)

comments.author: Peanut7
comments.body: Zero monetization here, fan project. I made this mainly for myself and my friends. If showdown is doing fine for the last 10 years I doubt Nintendo is coming after a hobby project with 10 players.

comments.author: ImCallingYouOutOnBS
comments.body: Wasn't this already a thing? Daily battle against red?

replies.author: Peanut7
replies.body: Yea that’s what inspired this. It was a good idea, but the execution wasn’t great IMO. Buggy, ads, AI logic was terrible, fight the same team every day. As a competitive player my whole life I wanted to do better.
